mods.name: Speedometer
mods.description: A lightweight speedometer item that shows your movement speed with 32 frames.

releases.notes: ## Speedometer v1.0.0 (Fabric 1.21.1) Speedometer adds a lightweight, compass-style item that visually tracks your movement speed using 32 custom needle frames. The faster you move, the farther the needle swings to the right, capping at the final frame. ### Features - **Real-time speed display** using a smooth 32-frame needle animation (`00` → `31`) - **Caps at frame 31** at high speeds (max needle position) - **Lightweight + modder-friendly**: simple item + model predicate (no invasive systems) - **Vanilla-friendly**: behaves like a normal handheld utility item ### Crafting Recipe Crafted like a Compass, but with Copper and Amethyst: ### Compatibility / Notes - **Fabric** for **Minecraft 1.21.1** - Designed to stay simple for cross-loader use via **Sinytra Connector** (where applicable) - Textures can be swapped easily in `assets/speedometer/textures/item/`
